notes: Modified cash basis school district; governmental funds only (no enterprise funds). Receipts/disbursements are the Total Governmental Funds column (p5-6), which includes the Winside Educational Facilities Leasing Corporation column. Beginning cash 11,187,504 and ending 4,523,652 are total fund balances (cash at bank, NLAF investments and county treasurer cash all included; investments not shown separately in the roll-forward). Statement of Activities (p2-3) shows beginning net position 8,085,348 (excludes the leasing corporation's 3,102,156 beginning balance) but the same ending 4,523,652. Transfers in (out) in the total column are 0: General Fund out 137,000 = Activities Fund in 37,000 + School Nutrition Fund in 100,000 (p8, p14, p15), so transfers_in/out are null. Taxes 2,989,581 split using the Statement of Activities (p2) and fund schedules. State Sources 3,735,386 split using the fund schedules (pp9, 15-18): nameplate capacity 953,445, homestead 29,386, property tax credit 1,511,883 (p2 prints 1,511,884, rounding), pro-rate motor vehicle 7,960, remainder state aid 1,232,712. Intermediate Sources split per General Fund schedule. Non-Revenue Receipts split: disposal of property 7,300 (sale of assets) and remainder as other (review). Debt Service 2,036,129 split by fund column using the Bond, Special Building and QCPU fund schedules (pp16-18): principal 1,205,000, interest and fees 333,751; the leasing corporation column 497,378 has no breakdown and is debt service (principal and interest combined). Detail: General Fund budget-vs-actual schedule (p9-11, by program, not by object) used; the General Fund components statement (p7) and the County Treasurer schedules (p19-20, pass-through of the same tax receipts) are not recorded in detail to avoid double counting; Depreciation Fund (p12) had no activity (beginning/ending 101) and is not recorded. Zero-actual lines not recorded. Budget column printed as '-' recorded as 0. General Fund Transfers 8000 (137,000) is recorded as other financing -137,000 and the printed total 5,233,425 includes it. Activities and School Nutrition fund transfers in (37,000 / 100,000) match the General Fund outflow. Balance sheet from the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p4, Total Governmental Funds column, fund balance by classification), whose totals equal the Statement of Net Position (p1, 4,523,652); no liabilities. Several printed totals differ from the sum of lines by $1-3 (rounding), recorded in report_discrepancies.
